zh.title: 美國海軍評估 MQ-9B SeaGuardian 無人機　支援海上巡邏與反潛任務
zh.summary: GA-ASI 公布 MQ-9B SeaGuardian 評估活動，支援美國海軍第七艦隊持續能力評估。
body: General Atomics Aeronautical Systems 於 2026 年 9 月 30 日宣布，美國海軍近期在華盛頓州 Whidbey Island 海軍航空站的海上巡邏與偵察部隊研討活動中，評估 MQ-9B SeaGuardian。公告未列出活動確切日期。
SeaGuardian 是 MQ-9B 的海上任務版本，透過由公司擁有並操作的合約模式，支援第七艦隊持續能力評估。此次活動不構成海軍新購機或交付公告。
研討活動集結部隊領導人、戰術人員及業界夥伴，檢視反潛作戰的戰術、技術與程序。GA-ASI 依要求提供航機，讓與會者近距離了解海上任務配置。

en.title: U.S. Navy evaluates MQ-9B SeaGuardian uncrewed aircraft at Whidbey Island
en.summary: GA-ASI says its maritime MQ-9B supports an ongoing capability assessment for the Seventh Fleet.
body: General Atomics Aeronautical Systems announced on September 30, 2026 that the U.S. Navy had recently evaluated MQ-9B SeaGuardian at a maritime patrol and reconnaissance gathering at Naval Air Station Whidbey Island, Washington. The exact event date was not given.

The maritime MQ-9B operates through a company-owned, company-operated contract supporting an ongoing Seventh Fleet capability assessment. This is an evaluation announcement, not a new aircraft purchase or delivery.

The gathering brought together leaders, tacticians and industry partners to review anti-submarine warfare tactics, techniques and procedures. GA-ASI supplied the aircraft for an up-close examination of its maritime configuration.

facts.claim: 2026-09-30 announcement; recent evaluation at NAS Whidbey Island; exact event date not given.
Maritime MQ-9B supports Seventh Fleet ongoing capability assessment under company-owned/company-operated contract.
MPRF gathering reviewed anti-submarine warfare tactics, techniques and procedures.
